observations: Red sportbike motorcycle with 'ZX' branding on the rear fairing.
The brand 'Zx' is visible on the left side of the fuel tank in photo 1.
The motorcycle is equipped with a single exhaust pipe and a rear-mounted tail light.
The front fairing has a clear visor and a digital display.
The handlebars feature control levers and a central switch.
The rear tire shows some dirt and wear, consistent with a used vehicle.
The motorcycle is parked on a tiled pavement.

claims.evidence: The ZX branding is visible, but the specific model number '12R' is not legible in any photo.
The photos show the exterior and some mechanical components, but internal mechanical health cannot be confirmed.

claims.claim: Bought new 6 months ago. Gears and brakes perfect, no rust, all parts original.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The motorcycle may not start or run.
risks.proof: A video of the engine starting and running.

risks.risk: The clutch may be worn or slipping.
risks.proof: A video of the motorcycle being ridden to demonstrate clutch engagement.

risks.risk: The internal engine may have significant wear or damage.
risks.proof: A video of the engine being revved and the sound of the engine running.

risks.risk: The rear suspension may be stiff or damaged.
risks.proof: A video showing the motorcycle being ridden and the rear wheel bouncing.

risks.risk: The fuel tank may be cracked or leaking.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the fuel tank interior and a video of the tank being filled.

proof_requests: Video of the motorcycle starting and running.
Video of the clutch being tested while riding.
Close-up photo of the engine and fuel tank.
Video of the rear suspension in motion.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identified from the photos. Since the seller's text is unverified, the item is priced at its worst-case functional state.
